title: 第15章 打脸了孙悟空说的都是真的第16章 才一万天兵这是看不起我楚某人啊
slug: 西游反正很无聊随便打个劫呗
lines: 角木蛟、奎木狼见到已经被折磨的不成人样的龟蛇二将。
“两位将军，你们怎么在这里？”
角木蛟见两人浑身是伤，不忍心问道。
两人看起来很惨，并没有受太重的伤。
只是现在被限制了仙力无法恢复。
“我们之前奉命来此降妖，没想到那厮如此恐怖……”
灵龟将军一脸无奈的回答道。
天蓬元帅亲自前来兴师问罪（胡吃海喝），两人还以为是青玄宗出现了败类，急忙赶来此地处理。
结果就成了这样。
“之前还没啥异样，不知为啥我们兄弟两人身上的仙力直接被限制了！”
角木蛟，奎木狼算是听明白了。
这两人在禁魔之地开启之前就被抓了。
也就是说，两人来之前还没有禁魔之地。
“两位宽心，我们是奉了玉皇大帝的命令，前来此地调查禁魔之地。”
角木蛟宽慰说道。
斗木獬、井木犴两人逃走了，相信用不了多久，天庭就会派兵来救他们了。
“想必现在已经收到了消息，用不了多久就会派人救我们的。”
“两位星君，其实我们是奉了九天荡魔祖师的命令前来此地降妖。”
“我们这么长时间没回去，九天荡魔祖师应该已经察觉到了……”
九天荡魔祖师，是凡间给予真武大帝的尊号。
然而事实上，真武大帝不但知道了，而且还来了。
只是暂时他已经顾不上两人了。
现在真武大帝正躲在域外秘境专心斩三尸。
然而就在此时。
一个身影走进了地牢。
正是之前负责审问龟蛇二将的二毛子。
啪！
一道皮鞭直接抽在了距离他最近的角木蛟身上。
“快说你们又是哪里唱大戏的？”
这一次楚云并没有吩咐，二毛子自告奋勇前来审问。
“我乃是天上的神仙，二十八星宿中的角木蛟。”
“哎呀！
又是天上的神仙，你们真以为我好糊弄是吧！”
之前大王命令他来审问两人。
可审了半天，对方一口咬定自己是天上的神仙。
好在大王没有追究他。
现在这两个人又自称是神仙。
看来是他的皮鞭还不够硬啊。
content_en:
Jiaomu Jiao and Kuimulang saw the two generals Turtle and Snake who had been tortured into an inhuman shape.
"Two generals, why are you here?"
Jiaomujiao couldn't bear to ask when he saw that the two of them were covered in injuries.
The two looked miserable and were not seriously injured.
It's just that now it's restricted and the immortal power cannot be restored.
"We were ordered to come here to slay demons before, but we didn't expect that guy to be so terrifying..."
General Linggui replied helplessly.
Marshal Tianpeng came to investigate in person (Hu was eating and drinking). The two of them thought that there was a scum in the Qingxuan Sect, so they hurried here to deal with it.
This is what happened.
"There was nothing strange before, but for some reason the immortal power of our two brothers was directly restricted!"
Jiaomujiao and Kuimulang finally understood.
These two people were caught before the Forbidden Demon Land was opened.
In other words, there was no place where demons were forbidden before the two came.
"Don't worry, you two, we are here to investigate the Forbidden Demon Land under the orders of the Jade Emperor."
Jiaomu Jiao said with relief.
Doumuxie and Jingmuyan escaped. I believe it won't be long before Heavenly Court sends troops to rescue them.
"I must have received the news by now, and someone will be sent to rescue us soon."
"Two Star Lords, we are actually here to subdue the demons under the orders of the founder of Jiutian Demon Demon."
"We haven't been back for such a long time, the founder of Jiutiandang Demon should have noticed..."
The Patriarch of Jiutiandang Demon is the honorific title given to Emperor Zhenwu in the mortal world.
However, in fact, Emperor Zhenwu not only knew about it, but also came.
But for the time being, he couldn't care about the two of them anymore.
Now Emperor Zhenwu is hiding in the secret realm outside the territory, concentrating on killing the three corpses.
But at this moment.
A figure walked into the dungeon.
It was Er Maozi who was responsible for interrogating the two generals Turtle and Snake.
Snap!
A whip struck directly at the horned wood dragon closest to him.
"Tell me, where did you get your acting career?"
This time Chu Yun did not give any orders, and Er Maozi volunteered to come for interrogation.
"I am a god in the sky, the horned wood dragon among the twenty-eight stars."
"Ouch!
It’s the gods in the sky again, you really think I’m easy to fool, don’t you? "
The king had previously ordered him to interrogate the two of them.
But after interrogating him for a long time, the other party insisted that he was a god in the sky.
Fortunately, the king did not pursue him.
Now these two people claim to be gods.
It seems that his whip is not strong enough.
Bang... bang...
………
